## Reporting security issues

If you discover a security issue, please follow these guidelines:

* Don't immediately reveal the problem in public.
  * So avoid the use of the Issue tracker.
* Please contact me directly using the [FreeBSD community forum](https://forums.freebsd.org/).
  * You can find my (= ShelLuser) profile [right here](https://forums.freebsd.org/members/shelluser.38324/).
* Always provide full details as well as any steps to reproduce the issue.

Security problems should always be investigated *before* public disclosure.
